name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to eligible poor and vulnerable families.
eligibility: Based on SECC deprivation criteria and socio-economic parameters; beneficiaries identified via NHA database. States may expand.
benefits: Cashless treatment at empanelled public/private hospitals; no cap on family size/age.
application_mode: Through Ayushman Bharat Kendras / CSC / hospital helpdesk
application_steps: Check eligibility via pmjay.gov.in 'Am I Eligible'.
Visit Ayushman Bharat / CSC kendra with ID.
Visit empanelled hospital; show card at helpdesk.
Cashless admission and treatment; claim settled directly.
processing_time: Card creation same day; treatment cashless at empanelled hospitals.
validity: Annual cover resets each financial year; card valid while eligible.
office_locator_info: Ayushman Bharat Digital Kendras; empanelled hospital list on portal.

faq.q: How do I know if I am eligible?
faq.a: Search your name by state/district/SECC ID on the Beneficiary Portal.

faq.q: Is there a premium to pay?
faq.a: No. The scheme is fully funded by Government; beneficiaries pay nothing at empanelled hospitals.

ai_summary: PM-JAY gives eligible families Rs. 5 lakh/year cashless hospitalization; free, SECC-based eligibility.
ai_explanation: PM-JAY covers secondary/tertiary hospitalization costs up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for poor and vulnerable households identified via SECC. Beneficiaries get an Ayushman card and receive cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals with no out-of-pocket premium.
